goal: Directly test for human GWAS associations of SLC27A5/SLC27A2 with MASLD/steatosis.

attempts.note: Legacy GWAS Catalog REST API retired ('no longer available').
v2 API does not expose a geneName-scoped association query at this path.
v2 studies search resolves but returns study-level records (no direct gene->association filter used).

outcome: Direct GWAS Catalog gene-scoped association lookup could NOT be completed via available API endpoints as of 2026-10-07 (endpoint deprecation/migration).
fallback: Genetic-association absence is instead established via Open Targets Platform v4 (artifact data/opentargets_transporter_masld_associations.json), which ingests GWAS Catalog + genetics portals and shows NO genetic_association datatype score for SLC27A5 or SLC27A2 against non-alcoholic fatty liver (EFO_1001248), MASH (MONDO_0007027), steatosis (EFO_0008527), or fatty liver disease (MONDO_0004790).
limitation: A bespoke GWAS Catalog summary-statistics scan was not performed; the negative is aggregator-mediated, not a primary-source exhaustive scan. Label: partial / aggregator-verified.
